verification_history: The initial wheel-suite run outside the checkout could not import two checkout-only test helpers. Running from the checkout root provided those helpers. The package path was verified against the installed wheel.

An intermediate full run produced an empty retrieval candidate in the existing 40 ms semantic-memory fixture. The same test then passed five isolated runs with its original settings. The final complete suite used the standard unittest discovery command.

In the first hosted Python 3.13 run, Chromium startup failed in two managed broadcast tests before the encoder checks. All four launcher scenarios subsequently passed locally against the installed wheel with a temporary scene. The tests retain their assertions for stream input, provider lifecycle and encoded video and audio.
